name: Loopz Gift Cards
author: Loopz Technologies Inc.

sections.description:
Increase sales and attract new customers by offering digital and physical gift cards for your business that can be redeem online and in-store on your POS. Create a branded gift card experience that works seamless on your WooCommerce store and your Point of Sale.
Integrates with WooCommerce, Clover, Square and Shopify. Enables gift cards to be sold and redeemed on all your connected merchant accounts.

External services

This plugin connects to the Loopz API to obtain gift card information of the store’s gift card program. It’s needed to enable gift card redemption on your store, enable gift card purchases and customization on your store, issue store credit from the order detail page and to show gift cards on the plugin’s dashboard.

This service is provided by “Loopz Technologies Inc.”: terms of use, terms of service, privacy policy.

Source Code and Development

The non-compiled source code for all compressed JavaScript and CSS assets in this plugin is included in the plugin itself, under the following directories:

  • assets/js/ — source JavaScript for admin settings, gift button, refund UI, and cart form
  • assets/css/ — source CSS for admin settings and button group styles
  • blocks/js/ — source JavaScript and SCSS for the Loopz Gift Card checkout block (React)

The compiled/minified output is located in the build/ directory.

Build instructions

This plugin uses @wordpress/scripts (webpack-based) to compile the JavaScript and CSS. To build the assets from source:

  1. Make sure you have Node.js 16 or later and npm installed.
  2. From the plugin root directory, install the build dependencies:
    npm install
  3. Build the compiled assets:
    npm run build
  4. For development with live reloading, use:
    npm run start

The npm run build command will compile all sources in assets/js/ and blocks/js/ into the build/ directory.
sections.installation:
Loopz Gift Cards requires a monthly subscription. Install our plugin and click \”Settings\” on the plugins screen of your WordPress site. Now click \”Connect\” on the Loopz Gift Cards settings page and you\’ll be guided through the setup process. Once you\’ve completed the setup of your gift card program, your store is ready to sell and redeem gift cards. You can manage your gift card program from the dashboard at https://dashboard.loopz.io

A gift card product is automatically created which customers can purchase through your checkout page. One this gift card product is purchased, a gift card will be created and emailed to the gift recipient. The gift recipient can redeem the gift card on your cart or checkout page by entering the card number in the order summary section.

This guide explains step by step the installation process.

Sell gift cards to boost your revenue with Loopz Gift Cards

With Loopz Gift Cards you can:

  • Sell gift cards: Offer digital gift cards of various denominations. Payment is handled through your WooCommerce store’s checkout page. Gift cards are delivered by email to the gift recipient.
  • Redeem gift cards: Customers can pay for orders on your WooCommerce store with a gift card. Control how gift card balances are applied to a cart’s line items. (Apply to shipping & taxes)
  • Refund orders as store credit: Instead of refunding an order’s payment, you can issue store credit to the customer instead. This locks in revenue and allows a customer to purchase other items on your store instead of refunding them.
  • Customize the gift experience: All customer facing screen and emails are customizable with your brand style. Create multiple card designs for gift purchasers to choose from.
  • Manage your gift card program: View metrics, manage outstanding gift cards and download reports of your gift card program, all on your gift card program’s dashboard.
  • Sync gift cards: Enable redemption of gift cards between your WooCommerce store and your Point of Sale. Connect your Square, Clover, Shopify or other WooCommerce stores to your gift card program.
sections.faq:
How do I receive the funds used to pay for a gift card on my store?

We use your WooCommerce checkout page to handle the purchase of gift cards. Any supported payment methods supported by your store can be used to purchase gift cards. Payout of those funds depends on the selected payment method used by the customer.

Where can I find documentation?

Refer to the Loopz Gift Cards documentation, including how to set up and configure the extension.

Where can I get support?

You can contact support through our support chat on your dashboard or by contacting us over email at support@loopz.io

I have existing gift cards, can I use them with Loopz Gift Cards?

Yes, we can import your active, outstanding gift cards into your gift card program so they can be redeemed on your WooCommerce store. This guide explains the details we need to be able to import your gift cards.
